title: Speakwow course
description: The front matter of courses/<slug>/index.md. A course is anything a teacher can teach by talking: a textbook volume, a school subject, a skill. Its units are the pages in courses/<slug>/units/. 一门课：可以是一册课本、一门学科或一项技能。

slug.description: Stable id, the same as the folder name, lowercase with dashes. Never rename it: students' progress points at it. 稳定 ID，与目录名相同，发布后不要改名。

title.description: The name students see. 学生看到的课程名。

description.description: What the course covers and where its outline came from. 课程简介和提纲来源。

subject.description: What is taught, as one lowercase word or two: english, math, physics, history, programming, piano… 科目，小写英文。

teaching_language.description: The language the lessons are held in, as a BCP 47 tag: en, zh, ja… For a language course, usually the language taught. 上课用的语言。

level.description: Who it is for, in words: "Grade 7", "CEFR A1–A2", "beginner adult". 适用水平。

grade.description: School grade, e.g. "7", for school courses. 年级。

term.description: "A" for the first term (上册), "B" for the second (下册).

region.description: Where this course or textbook is used, e.g. "江苏". 使用地区。

publisher.description: Textbook publisher, if the course follows a textbook. 出版社。

standard.description: The curriculum standard it follows, if any. 对应的课程标准。

sources.description: Where the content comes from, so learners and maintainers can read the original. Cite, never copy. 资料来源：只引用，不照抄。

maintainers.description: GitHub usernames of the people who look after this course. 维护者的 GitHub 用户名。
